issues.legal_issue: An objection that an arbitral award is unstamped or unregistered is not to be decided in proceedings to set aside the award, but may be raised when enforcement is sought.
material_facts: The parties referred a dispute over joint family property to arbitration, and the arbitral tribunal made an award.
Parties applied to set aside the award and objected that it was inadmissible and unenforceable because it was not stamped or registered.
The High Court set aside the order rejecting those applications on the ground that the award was unstamped and unregistered; no enforcement proceeding was before the courts.
issues.conclusion: The stamping and registration objection was premature in the proceedings to set aside the award. The High Court's judgment was set aside, the remaining objections under Section 34 were remitted to it, and the parties remained free to raise stamping and registration objections at the enforcement stage.
issues.legal_principle: Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 permits an award to be set aside only on the grounds enumerated there, so an objection concerning stamping or registration is not a ground to be decided in that proceeding. The question is relevant when the award is presented for enforcement under Section 36, where admissibility objections may be raised under Section 17 of the Registration Act. The question falls within Section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure rather than Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act. No earlier cases were cited.

rule.if: award_setting_aside_proceeding and formal_admissibility_objection and not enforcement_proceeding

predicates.award_setting_aside_proceeding: A party has brought a proceeding seeking to set aside an arbitral award.
predicates.formal_admissibility_objection: A party objects that the award is inadmissible or unenforceable because it was not properly stamped or registered.
predicates.enforcement_proceeding: A party has brought a proceeding to enforce the award.
predicates.stamp_registration_objection_reserved_fo: The stamping or registration objection is not decided in the award-setting-aside proceeding and may be raised in the enforcement proceeding.

issues.definition: When a party raises a stamping or registration objection in a proceeding to set aside an award, and no enforcement proceeding is underway, the objection is reserved for the enforcement proceeding.
